summary: ADR-2 group A: explicit lens reconciliation (R-1), one round budget (R-2), packet reads spec.md sections (R-3), ADRs in .aegis/decisions (R-4), pure packet + task claim (R-5), structured next steps (R-6), no AEGIS_SKIP_GATE (R-7), orchestrator no longer sets gated (R-8), answers complete and constitution drafted (R-9); plus set_answer derives status from the ledger.
deviations: Implemented by the session agent, not by a dispatched aegis-builder: the patches change the builder loop itself, so a builder could not run under the unfixed loop.
The constitution is a draft awaiting human signature; check setup passes on content, not on signature.
The task gate cannot pass `trace` until the baseline tree is committed: every file is untracked against base_sha, so 119 files count as changed by this task.

ABANDONED 2026-09-17 after its third and last review round left seven blocking findings in one class (the commit-hook exemption, baseline history, answers.json). Per the round cap a fourth round was not started; the mechanism was simplified by deletion and re-issued as TASK-UNBLOCK-02 with a fresh round budget and fresh lenses.
